name: blood-of-dawnwalker-update-1-2-new-game-plus-20261114
lines:
حسب يوروغيمر (Eurogamer)،
تحصل The Blood of Dawnwalker
على هذا الوضع

من أنهى خاتمة اللعبة (Epilogue)
يعود بمستواه ومهاراته وأغراضه

الحد الأقصى للمستوى فيه 100
مع قوة موحدة للأعداء في كل المناطق

موعد التحديث المقرر:
أي يوم من الأسبوع المقبل
headline:
لعبة Dawnwalker
تحصل على New Game Plus
label: تقرير

angle.hook: The Blood of Dawnwalker is getting New Game Plus: finishers keep level, skills and items and the level cap rises to 100
angle.why_now: Eurogamer reported on 13 Nov, quoting developer Rebel Wolves, that Update 1.2 is planned for next week; no Arabic outlet has carried it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players who finished the September RPG can replay it with their build; the game costs 229 AED on Steam in the UAE and 239 SR in Saudi Arabia, with no Arabic among its languages
angle.payoff: the update is planned for any day next week and the full patch notes are still to come, so only the New Game Plus details Rebel Wolves gave are confirmed by the report

tried: Steam Launch Trailer: narrated over the whole 92 s (faster-whisper small, vad on and off, 14 Nov), horror scenes with a demon
Steam Update 1.1 Trailer: PEGI 18 card at 0 to 3 s, a burnt-in feature caption on every gameplay shot, blood in the combat, one dialogue line at 35 to 39 s, and an AVAILABLE NOW key-art card
Steam Features Trailer (6 min): narrated throughout with burnt-in subtitles, very dark, vampire feeding scenes
Steam Story Trailer: download failed here and the Cinematic and Summer Game Fest trailers were not opened

bed_reason: Stills Reel on official Steam screenshots, which have no sound of their own, and every official Steam trailer of The Blood of Dawnwalker checked (Launch Trailer: narration under all 92 s; Update 1.1 Trailer: music-led but burnt-in captions on every shot, blood, a PEGI 18 card, dialogue at 35 to 39 s; Features Trailer: narration through all 6 minutes with burnt-in subtitles) has narration, burnt-in text or blood, so our bed plays under the stills and the jingle on the end card.
